title: Documentation chaos indexed but not fixed — port P0 docs now
what_needed: DOCUMENTATION_CHAOS_TRACKER.md indexes 19+ scattered documents across 3 partitions, but none have been ported to the repo. The tracker is an index, not a fix. P0 docs (Omega Positioning Framework S-11, Lilith Persona S-03, XNAI Blueprint S-06) need to be ported NOW.
why: An index of chaos is not order. It's a map of the problem, not the solution. P0 docs are blocking: they contain strategic decisions and entity definitions that other agents need. Every session that references scattered docs without porting them is compounding the problem.
producer_hint: Start with S-11 (Omega Positioning Framework, 12 files, 30 min). Then S-03 (Lilith Persona JSON, 10 min). Then S-06 (XNAI Blueprint, 15 min).
